description: This file defines the EnterpriseCallbackControls class, which manages dynamic callback disabling features in an enterprise environment, including checking headers and request parameters to determine if certain callbacks should be disabled.

classes.name: EnterpriseCallbackControls
classes.description: Provides static methods for checking if callbacks are disabled dynamically based on request headers or other parameters in an enterprise environment.

methods.name: Optional[List[str]] get_disabled_callbacks(litellm_params: dict, standard_callback_dynamic_params: StandardCallbackDynamicParams)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of disabled callbacks from request headers or request parameters.

methods.name: _should_allow_dynamic_callback_disabling()
methods.description: Determines whether dynamic callback disabling is permitted based on system configuration and user privileges.
